text.p: STAT Healthcare Inc said on Monday that it will redeem its class A redeemable common stock purchase warrants on December 9, 1996 for $0.05 per warrant.
Each class A warrant entitles its holder to purchase one share of STAT common stock at an exercise price of $4.50 per share, STAT Healthcare said.
The class A warrants will remain exercisable in accordance with their terms until 1700 EST on December 6, 1996, STAT Healthcare said.

As previously announced on October 7, 1996, STAT agreed to merge with a unit of American Medical Response in a stock swap that would covert STAT common stock into 0.25 of a share of American Medical Response.
